source_role: explicit requirement packet for what the first primary Vanadium page capture must contain
purpose: Turn the current Vanadium blocker into one primary-capture checklist that is specific enough for a later raw-page extraction pass.

primary_source_target.required_outcome: page-confirmed primary capture for Tc and Theta-related row context

must_show: page span visible or inferable from the primary source itself
article title clearly tied to the captured pages
source path or mirrored raw capture path
quoted text containing the Tc statement
enough row context to show that the value belongs to the same Vanadium sample family under review
quoted text containing the Theta or normal-state fit statement
normalized value in Kelvin if explicit
clear note on whether the captured quantity is being used as the active phonon proxy

secondary_followup_after_primary_capture.followup_need: compare the open-fulltext lambda = 0.91 capture against the now page-confirmed Vanadium row context
compare the open-fulltext mu-star captures against the now page-confirmed Vanadium row context and decide whether the benchmark row may keep mu* = 0.11

success_condition: The packet succeeds only when a future capture can page-confirm the Vanadium primary source and close the Tc and Theta identity gap.
claim_boundary: This packet defines capture requirements only. It does not certify any value and does not authorize a patch.
